images.title: A cut repeats across the fold
images.purpose: Show that a notch cut on a folded edge appears again as a mirror image when the sheet opens.
images.composition: Two sheets side by side with wide space between them, folded on the left and opened on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: one folded sheet 3 cm wide, teal #0072B2, with one triangular notch cut from the folded edge. Right: the same sheet opened flat, 6 cm wide, teal, with a vertical dashed grey #6B7280 fold line in the middle and 1 diamond shaped hole centred on the fold line, made of the notch and its exact mirror image. Exactly 2 sheets, 1 notch, 1 hole, 1 fold line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a single triangular notch on the opened sheet
images.takeaway: A cut on the fold appears again as a mirror image.
images.description: A folded teal sheet with one notch on the folded edge, and the same sheet opened with a diamond hole made of the notch and its mirror image on the fold line.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say how the hole will look after the sheet is opened.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
